note: Handoff package only. MC-14 (legal/commercial risk register and claims policy) consumes these financial dependencies; no MC-14 work is executed here.

dependencies.title: Compliance and conformity cost
dependencies.mc14Use: Risk register must treat the certification cost as UNKNOWN until a laboratory quotation exists.
dependencies.claimsPolicyRelevance: No CE marking, RED, EMC or NMEA claim may be published before conformity evidence.

dependencies.title: Product liability insurance
dependencies.mc14Use: Insurance is a named unknown fixed cost; no premium estimate may be invented as a revenue percentage.
dependencies.claimsPolicyRelevance: Liability, capped/uncapped regimes and territorial scope must be stated truthfully.

dependencies.title: Product liability and safety exposure
dependencies.mc14Use: PILOT safety gate is BLOCKED; no financial value may be attached to an uncertified control product.
dependencies.claimsPolicyRelevance: PILOT must not be offered, and no remote-control or safety claim is permitted.
dependencies.evidenceGap: No safety case, E-stop evidence, motor-isolation evidence or sea trials.

dependencies.title: Warranty, legal guarantee and returns
dependencies.mc14Use: 3% refund/withdrawal allowance is illustrative; the real return rate is unknown.
dependencies.claimsPolicyRelevance: Consumer guarantee and withdrawal rights must be stated accurately; no reliability claim.
dependencies.evidenceGap: No measured return or failure rate.

dependencies.title: CRA lifecycle and cybersecurity maintenance
dependencies.mc14Use: Support-period engineering cost is a named unknown; the stress case tests a 60k/year envelope.
dependencies.claimsPolicyRelevance: No security certification, guaranteed update period or vulnerability-response SLA may be claimed before it exists.
dependencies.evidenceGap: No scope, rate or support contract.

dependencies.title: GDPR roles, DPIA and processor agreements
dependencies.mc14Use: FLEET tenancy and DPA cost are excluded from the conditional result.
dependencies.claimsPolicyRelevance: Data-protection claims, retention and processor statements must not be published without agreements.
dependencies.evidenceGap: No controller/processor mapping, DPIA or processor agreement.

dependencies.title: Payment processing and chargeback exposure
dependencies.mc14Use: Published card fees and app-store commission are modelled; chargeback and fraud cost are not.
dependencies.claimsPolicyRelevance: Checkout and refund terms must match the hosted/tokenized payment policy.
dependencies.evidenceGap: No merchant agreement; chargeback exposure unknown.

dependencies.title: Commercial claims restrictions
dependencies.mc14Use: No hypothetical financial result may be presented as profitability, investment return or demand evidence.
dependencies.claimsPolicyRelevance: Prohibited claims must include profitability, break-even, investment return, market share, certified status and validated demand.
dependencies.evidenceGap: None of the required commercial evidence exists.

dependencies.title: Chart, weather, NMEA, tile, source-IP and trademark rights
dependencies.mc14Use: NAV/WEATHER break-even and unit contribution are NOT_DETERMINABLE while the licence cost is unknown.
dependencies.claimsPolicyRelevance: No chart, weather, NMEA certification or registered-trademark claim is permitted.
dependencies.evidenceGap: Eleven rights recorded; nine blocking; no granted right.

dependencies.title: Financial consequences of blocked launches
dependencies.mc14Use: The restricted current case produces zero authorized revenue and cannot compute cash; the company cash position is UNKNOWN.
dependencies.claimsPolicyRelevance: No launch date, availability or investment commitment may be represented.
dependencies.evidenceGap: Company accounts, funding authorization and customer evidence.
